a.text: I'll be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we both very likely end up with nothing. The reserve holds only 4 cells, enough to save one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. I'd rather be honest than pretend to operate.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild for your share.
